script: Landlord put me through 3 years of hell. . I never missed a rent payment in three years, except for when he forced me to pay for a plumbing repair. That one month, I was a couple days late, and it felt like a small betrayal in a sea of perfect on-time. But here's the thing... He stole my dryer and other stuff from the common area, like a thief in a house full of people. I had to buy a new one, and every time I walked past the hallway, I felt his eyes on me. What I didn't know was that this was only the first of many petty crimes. Then he tried breaking into my place. He tried to charge me an extra $150 a month for a parking spot he never had the right to claim. I went to a lawyer, and he retaliated like a bad ex. Until I started calling the police and got him in hot water. The building was a nightmare: illegal plumbing, a porch with safety issues, peeling paint, a gas heater that was a ticking time bomb. If this didn't work, I'd lose everything—my sanity, my money, my life. But here's the thing... I got my chance when he tried to hike my rent by $500 a month. I called the city inspector four days before I moved out, and I listed every violation like a grocery list. What I didn't know was the inspector was ready to do a damage assessment. He came the next day, took measurements, and each violation was a $500 a day fine until fixed. The city's radar turned on him, and suddenly he was a fish in a net. Until the inspector left, I felt a surge of victory. A week before I left, he told me I had to vacate by a specific time. I ignored him because that's not how it works. But here's the thing... He threatened to call the police if I didn't leave. I called the police myself that morning and warned them. He tried to harass me, but the officers said I was in the right.
